encounter: P12 play_order 138, E0164 TRAINER_RANDALL (Petalburg Gym room 1 - the swarm), cap 42
availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27, after the desert safeguards of C26 and after Ashen Woods and the Trick House. The live cap is still 42 - Norman's Balance Badge is what raises it to 48, and that happens at the END of this Gym, so every room in it is fought at 42. No Surf yet. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map already walked, including the Mirage Tower and Sandstrewn Ruins interiors, which C26 places immediately before Norman. Route 118 and New Mauville sources are excluded. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species is used.
plan: Randall's room is six Normal types whose shared thesis is multi-hit damage and redirection. The dossier's own crack list names the honest counterplay first: Ghost immunity, contact punishment and physical mitigation. This party is four Ghosts and two support bodies, and the point is structural rather than clever - Tail Slap, Double Hit, Population Bomb, Body Slam, Double-Edge and Fake Out are all Normal, and a Ghost takes none of them. That specifically blanks Ambipom's Technician Fake Out, which is the room's opening play. Mega Sableye is the Mega slot because Magic Bounce reflects Dunsparce's Glare and Maushold's Encore - the two status moves that are the room's actual disruption - and because Ghost/Dark is weak only to Fairy, which Randall does not have. Foul Play uses the target's own Attack, and every member of this room is a physical attacker. Cofagrigus is here for Mummy: Skill Link and Technician are the two abilities holding the swarm together and a Dark or Bug contact move into Cofagrigus removes one of them permanently. Two Rocky Helmets punish the contact the room cannot avoid. Amoonguss holds Spore and Rage Powder as a second redirection route that competes with Maushold's Follow Me.
